result.instructions: Tools for Cartesia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Read this paragraph aloud with a calm British voice and give me the mp3."; "Transcribe this call recording and tell me the spoken language and length."; "List the English voices in my account and show which ones I cloned.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cartesia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cartesia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cartesia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cartesia_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cartesia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cartesia_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the callable Sonic (text-to-speech) and Ink (speech-to-text) model ids. Use it to choose a model_id for cartesia_text_to_speech. Cartesia API: GET /models.

capability.description: Return only tts (text-to-speech) or stt (speech-to-text) models. Omit for both.

tools.name: cartesia_list_voices
tools.title: List voices
tools.description: List voices your account can use: your own clones and the public library. Filter by search text, language or gender. The result has has_more; pass the last voice id as starting_after to get the next page. Cartesia API: GET /voices.

q.description: Search text matched against voice names and descriptions.

language.description: Language or locale, for example en or en-GB.

is_owner.description: true for voices your account owns (clones); false for library voices.

starting_after.description: Voice id: return the voices after this one (next page).

ending_before.description: Voice id: return the voices before this one (previous page).

tools.name: cartesia_get_voice
tools.title: Get a voice
tools.description: Get one voice by id: name, language, accents, gender, status and access. Cartesia API: GET /voices/{id}.

tools.name: cartesia_list_accents
tools.title: List accents
tools.description: List catalog accents with their ids. Use is_localizable=true to find accents for cartesia_localize_voice. Cartesia API: GET /accents.

is_localizable.description: true: only accents you can localize a voice into.

language.description: Filter by language, for example en or es.

locale.description: Filter by locale, for example en-GB.

tools.name: cartesia_get_usage_credits
tools.title: Get credit usage
tools.description: Get the credit usage of the account for a time window (ISO 8601 date-times). Use it to check spend before a large batch. Cartesia API: GET /usage/credits.

start_ts.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

end_ts.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: cartesia_text_to_speech
tools.title: Text to speech
tools.description: Generate speech from text with a Cartesia voice. Returns the audio as base64 (mp3 by default, or wav). Uses Cartesia credits. Audio above 2 MB is refused: shorten the text. Cartesia API: POST /tts/bytes.

model_id.description: TTS model id, for example sonic-3.6 (default). See cartesia_list_models.

language.description: Language code of the text. Default en.

tools.name: cartesia_speech_to_text
tools.title: Transcribe audio
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file to text with the Ink model. Send the file as base64 (wav, mp3, flac, m4a, ogg, webm and more). Returns the text, language and duration. Cartesia API: POST /stt.

audio_base64.description: The audio file bytes, base64 encoded (up to 2.5 MB decoded). A data: URL prefix is accepted.

filename.description: File name with its extension, for example call.wav or clip.mp3.

tools.name: cartesia_clone_voice
tools.title: Clone a voice
tools.description: Create a new voice from one audio clip (up to 2.5 MB). Use only a voice whose speaker gave explicit consent, as the Cartesia Acceptable Use Policy requires. Returns the new voice (its id goes to cartesia_text_to_speech). Cartesia API: POST /voices/clone.

audio_base64.description: The audio file bytes, base64 encoded (up to 2.5 MB decoded). A data: URL prefix is accepted.

filename.description: File name with its extension, for example call.wav or clip.mp3.

language.description: Language spoken in the clip, for example en.

tagline.description: A few words about the voice (32 characters at most).

tools.name: cartesia_localize_voice
tools.title: Localize a voice
tools.description: Create a new voice from one of your voices, adapted to another accent (for example british). Get accent ids from cartesia_list_accents with is_localizable=true. Cartesia API: POST /voices/localize.

name.description: Name for the new localized voice.

description.description: Short description of the new voice.

tagline.description: A few words about the voice (32 characters at most).

tools.name: cartesia_update_voice
tools.title: Update a voice
tools.description: Change the name, tagline or description of one of your voices. Give at least one field. Cartesia API: PATCH /voices/{id}.

tagline.description: A few words about the voice (32 characters at most).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cartesia
prompts.description: What you can do with Cartesia here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: read_text_aloud_in_a_chosen_voice
prompts.title: Read text aloud in a chosen voice
prompts.description: Choose a voice and a model, then generate speech from the text. The audio comes back as mp3 or wav. Audio above 2 MB is refused, so split long text.

prompts.name: transcribe_an_audio_recording
prompts.title: Transcribe an audio recording
prompts.description: Send an audio file to the Ink speech-to-text model. Get the text, the spoken language and the duration.

prompts.name: search_voices_by_language_or_gender
prompts.title: Search voices by language or gender
prompts.description: Search your voices and the public library by text, language or gender. Read one voice and the accents it can use.

prompts.name: create_a_localized_voice_in_another_accent
prompts.title: Create a localized voice in another accent
prompts.description: List the accents that a voice can be localized into. Create a new voice from one of your voices in another accent, such as British.

prompts.name: clone_a_voice_with_the_speaker_s_consent
prompts.title: Clone a voice with the speaker's consent
prompts.description: Create a voice from one audio clip of up to 2.5 MB. Use it only for a speaker who gave explicit consent, as the Cartesia policy requires.

prompts.name: check_credit_use_before_a_large_batch
prompts.title: Check credit use before a large batch
prompts.description: Read the credit usage of the account for a time window. Check it before a large batch of audio.
